headline: Dubai bail claim: Race to bring Benazir home sparks
summary: Efforts to repatriate Benazir are intensifying following claims regarding his bail status in Dubai.
details: Claims regarding bail in Dubai have sparked a renewed race to bring Benazir back to Bangladesh.

The process of bringing him home is the current focus of the following the bail claim.
Further developments regarding his legal status in Dubai and the repatriation process are being monitored.

headline: Home Minister says law firm appointed to seek Benazir's return from UAE
summary: The government is taking legal steps to bring back Benazir Rahman, exploring options to ensure her return to Bangladesh.
details: The Home Minister of Bangladesh has announced that a law firm has been appointed to facilitate the return of Benazir Rahman from the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
This move is part of the government's effort to ensure the legal return of Benazir Rahman to the country.
The law firm will handle the legal complexities and navigate the UAE's legal system to seek her return.
The government is exploring all available legal avenues to bring Benazir Rahman back to Bangladesh.
caption:
A law firm has been appointed to seek the return of Benazir Rahman from the UAE.
